senses.gloss: Vaḍavā^1, the mother of the horses. § 221 (Caitrarathap.): I, 170, 6488.
Vaḍavā^6, a river. § 494 (Āṅgirasa): III, 222, 14232 (among the rivers who are mothers of fires).

Vaḍavāmukha^1, name of the submarine fire at Vaḍavāmukha(ṃ). § 30b (Samudra): I, 21, 1220 (ºdīptāgnes toyahavyapradaḥ, sc. the ocean).--§ 552 (Goharaṇap.): IV, 50, 1580 (agniḥ).--§ 616 (Sauptikap.): X, 6, 226 (pāvakaḥ).--§ 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 339, ††12864 (agniḥ = Mahāpurusha). Cf. Vaḍavāvaktra.--Do.^2 = Śiva (1000 names^2).
Vaḍavāmukha^3, a ṛshi. § 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 343, XIII), ††13222 (maharshiḥ, incarnation of Nārāyaṇa, cursed the ocean, saying that its water should only be drinkable for the vaḍavāmukha).

Vaḍavāmukha(m) (the mare's head, in the ocean). § 571 (Ulūkadūtāgamanap.): V, 160, 5529 (Kāmboja-v ºṃ, sc. purushodadhiṃ); 161, 5574 (do.).--§ 599 (Jayadrathavadhap.): VII, 135, 5556 (ºmadhyasthaḥ…mānavaḥ).-§ 603 (Nārāyaṇāstramokshap.): VII, 202, 9608 (ºeti(!) vyākhyātaṃ pivaṃs (ºat, B) toyamayaṃ haviḥ, one of the faces of Śiva).--§ 704 (Mokshadh.): XII, 302, 11168 (ºsāgaraṃ).-§ 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 343, XIII), ††13222 (ºsañjñitena, drinks the water of the ocean).--§ 742 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 38, 2230.--§ 773d (Śiva): XIII, 162, 7531 (the face of Śiva). Cf. Vaḍavāvaktra(ṃ).
Vaḍavāvaktra(ṃ) = Vaḍavāmukha(ṃ). § 745c (Cyavana-Kuśikasaṃv.): XIII, 56, 2909 (there Ūrva will throw the fire of his wrath; cf. Aurvopākhyāna(ṃ)).
